messages:
Nora (AM): Quick sync - SolarisBank wants Redwood POC to validate replacing OmniAPI. Focus: prompt parity, deterministic reranking, security Qs, and final pricing. Need owners.
Ben (Sales Eng): We'll need a representative corpus + info on OmniAPI's rounding and length policies. I can handle pricing math and contract impacts.
Rach (SE): For parity I'll check tokenization diffs, stop token handling, and any in-flight prompt truncation logic OmniAPI uses. Also will test streaming chunking behavior.
Eli (Infra): Customer requires static egress IPs and an allowlist. Also expect audit log forwarding to their SIEM via syslog or S3. Dedicated recommended for throughput.
shield-bot: SQ highlights: KMS=yes, SOC2=yes, retention default 90d. Provide docs: /sales/presales/sec/sq-answers.md
Nora (AM): SolarisBank also asked: can we match OmniAPI's 'sticky session' behavior for chat sessions? What's the effort?
Ben (Sales Eng): We can approximate via session affinity + KV cache pinning. Might cost extra if long-lived. I'll quantify.
Rach (SE): Acceptance: 92% of prompts top-1 embedding similarity >=0.86; median latency <300ms on Dedicated for 256-token. Also require <5% response formatting diffs.
Eli (Infra): Cutover: blue/green with 24hr monitoring at 10% increments. Provide rollback playbook and CIDR list.
Nora (AM): Owners: Ben=billing+contract, Rach=parity harness, Eli=infra+cidrs, Nora=customer comms. Deliverables by Friday lunchtime?
Ben (Sales Eng): Yup, spreadsheet + draft legal notes.
Rach (SE): I'll run smoke on Friday 09:00 PT and share results.
Eli (Infra): CIDRs + runbook in by EOD Thursday.
Nora (AM): Thanks, will tee up call with SolarisBank after smoke.
